'''Deflaros''' was the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] leader of a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] based criminal organization known as the [[Deflarians]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> the Deflarians hijacked a ship piloted by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Donovan (captain)|Donovan]] of the [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] and stole its cargo of weapons. They then crashed a ship of the same model than Donovan's to cover the theft of the cargo. Donovan himself was captured and imprisoned in the Deflarian bunker.<ref name="SWG:DC" /> CorSec [[Inspector/Legends|Inspector]] [[Cora (Human)|Cora]] therefore hired a spacer to investigate the situation. The spacer managed to find the location of the bunker, infiltrated the building and rescued the imprisoned Captain Donovan.<ref name="SWG:WHtD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|What Happened to Donovan?|Corellia}}</ref> After Donovan revealed that his ship was hijacked, Cora tasked spacers to assault a Deflarian camp, whose location was provided by Donovan. During the raid, the spacers killed several Deflarian guards and mechanics, as well as Deflaros and his bodyguards, and secured Donovan's ship and its cargo.<ref name="SWG:DC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Deflaros was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Deflaros was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 28 Notes for April 26, 2006|Publish 28]]," on [[April 26]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=Announcements&message.id=3077&jump=true|text=What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th}}</ref>
